versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI 智能广告优化系统 (AI Intelligent Ad Optimization System).
- Provides automated ad optimization including smart bidding, creative (A/B) testing, audience targeting, budget allocation, and ROI analysis.
- Multiple pricing tiers based on budget: Basic, Pro, and Enterprise.
- Supports scenarios such as display, information feed, search, and social media ads.
- Built with Python, FastAPI, and includes optimization algorithms and budget optimization features.
